The ingredient declaration, net quantity, manufacturer, marketer, country of origin and shelf life are the pack's mandated declarations under Rule 149 of the Drugs & Cosmetics Rules and the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, reproduced by the retailer. Read from the page's own labelled fields, never from its marketing copy. No price or availability is taken.
